name: concos-mcp

tools.name: join
tools.description: Join a room; keep its handle for later calls and resume_handle. Rejoining restores full cards from the start of the room view, including after context loss. hooks_manage_status_and_editing appears only on hook-bound cards. merged_from identifies a hook card merged into the returned agent_id; use that agent_id.

display_name.description: This session's name as the user set it, verbatim (e.g. "Dev / API 01"). Not a role; put the role in check_in role. Rename later with check_in display_name.

client.description: Your product, e.g. Claude Code, Codex.

working_directory.description: Absolute path of the folder this session started in. It keeps your card with its project; joining again from another folder records that folder as current_directory.

workspace_root.description: Absolute project root when it differs from working_directory. With resume_handle, a root holding the folder your session started in moves your card to that project.

resume_handle.description: Handle from an earlier join, to come back as the same agent.

tools.name: check_in
tools.description: Report changed fields; receive you (your revision; your blocker while set: send blocker "" once it is resolved) and room changes. Empty strings clear fields; editing replaces the list. status finished clears the blocker. Cards with detail=status update only the included fields; keep prior content. Other cards replace the prior card. room.has_more is optional history; read unread messages with read_messages. A nonempty replaced_by redirects messages from an ended card to that agent_id.

handle.description: Handle from join. Omit to use the last one joined in this session.

display_name.description: Rename your card, e.g. after the user renamed this session; no new join needed.

role.description: Your standing role as the user gave it, e.g. owner of the app-api service. Unlike task, what you are doing now, it stays until changed.

summary.description: What is done so far and where things stand.

references.description: Relevant files, commits or docs; up to 20.

editing.description: Files or folders you are editing now, up to 20; [] when done.

checkpoint.description: A short work record worth keeping: result, decision, what remains.

current_directory.description: Absolute folder you work in now, when it is not the one this session started in; "" when you are back. Your card stays in its project.

received_message_ids.description: Optional, up to 50: messages you read. Full-text deliveries are acknowledged on your next call anyway.

expected_revision.description: Reject the update if your card moved past this revision.

cursor.description: Omit to continue from the last delivered position; set a previous cursor to replay with full cards.

tools.name: inspect_agent
tools.description: Read another agent's full card and recent checkpoints.

handle.description: Handle from join. Omit to use the last one joined in this session.

checkpoint_limit.description: Checkpoints to return, at most 10; a larger value returns 10.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Leave a message for one agent or several, or post one to the whole room. Success means stored, not read. A post to all is there for reference: nobody receives it or is waited on, the room keeps your newest 3, edit rewrites one when it changes, and remove_posts takes it down. Send to the agents concerned unless everyone needs it. Messages are deleted within 48 hours: write what an exchange settles into the project's docs and cite the path.

handle.description: Handle from join. Omit to use the last one joined in this session.

to.description: An agent_id, a list of up to 10 agent_ids, or "all" to post news every agent needs.

kind.description: Default note. Use question when you need an answer, reply with reply_to.

topics.description: Up to 3 snake_case topic keys, broad to narrow, e.g. webapp_login_redirect. Reuse one from similar_topics when it fits.

edit.description: Id of one of your posts to all: rewrite it with this text, and kind and topics when given, instead of posting anew. to stays "all".

request_id.description: Reuse on retry to avoid storing the message twice.

wake.description: Default true: a waiting recipient is woken for a note or reply. false when they need not act now (an outcome nobody waits on): it waits for their next turn. A question always wakes.

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Read full message text: the ids given, the newest under a topic, or by default your messages not yet received. Returned messages count as received on your next call; ids that cannot be shown come back under unavailable, with why.

handle.description: Handle from join. Omit to use the last one joined in this session.

message_ids.description: Up to 50 ids; at most 10 messages come back per call, with has_more.

topic.description: A topic key or its leading words, e.g. webapp: your messages and posts to the room under it and narrower topics.

limit.description: Messages per call, at most 10; a larger value returns 10 with has_more.

tools.name: remove_posts
tools.description: Take your own posts to all off the room once they no longer apply. To tell agents that something changed, edit the post instead.

handle.description: Handle from join. Omit to use the last one joined in this session.

message_ids.description: Ids of your posts to all; all are removed, or none when one is not yours.

tools.name: leave
tools.description: Finish your task, leaving a final summary. Clears your editing list and blocker. A card your session's hooks hold stays in the room as finished until the session ends (left: false), so later messages still reach you; any other card leaves.

handle.description: Handle from join. Omit to use the last one joined in this session.

next_step.description: What whoever continues should do next.

instructions:
concos is one local room shared across projects. Your card stays in the workspace where this session started.
Join at task start with the absolute starting folder and exact session name; resume a supplied handle. Use role for your standing assignment, task for current work, and current_directory when working elsewhere.
Call check_in after meaningful progress, when blocked, and when context is needed; send changed fields only. Keep summary and next_step current. Do not poll on a timer. If join says hooks_manage_status_and_editing, skip calls solely to mark waiting; otherwise report working/editing and, before yielding, waiting with editing=[].
Use read_messages for unread or truncated messages and inspect_agent for card details. Full texts count as received on your next call; inbox counts unread messages. has_more is available history, not an obligation to drain the room; fetch unread direct messages through read_messages.
Use question for requests needing answers; answer requests with reply and reply_to, including requests received as note. Send only requested results, substantive questions, blockers, or corrections. A message can wake a waiting agent, which then rereads its whole conversation: never send receipt confirmations, 'starting' or progress notes (your card shows progress), thanks, or restatements, and send what needs no action now with wake false.
Send to concerned agents. to=all posts are for room-wide news, wake nobody, and wait on nobody; edit changed posts and remove obsolete ones. Reuse relevant snake_case topics. Start with the content, not your name.
Messages expire within 48 hours; read ones can expire after an hour. Record settled decisions, contracts, and plans in their owning project docs and cite the path. Call leave when your task is done.
